# E0432: value that can't reach another task

A view can't reach another task, since it must not outlive its source. Capture the value it views.

- Rule: [`shared.tasks-and-modes`](../../reference/14-tasks.md#shared.tasks-and-modes)
- Reported at: the value given to `Shared.new`, or the capture of the task's function.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0432:6
use std.task
use std.view

fn counted(xs: List<i64>) -> i64 / async {
  let v = view.View.all(xs)
  task.spawn(|| v.len()).await()
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
use std.task

fn counted(xs: List<i64>) -> i64 / async {
  task.spawn(|| xs.len()).await()
}
```

## What the compiler prints

  5 │   let v = view.View.all(xs)
    │       ─ `v` is a view from here
  6 │   task.spawn(|| v.len()).await()
    │                 ^

A view can't reach another task, since it must not outlive its source. Capture
